name: deferred_loop_from_scratch
description: G-5, story B, with T-1's defaults: a deferred material loop built from a Blank pipeline with Studio alone. New Project (F-2) proposes the name; a Cube turned 45 degrees about the vertical, typed as one angle, so two faces meet the camera, and a Floor from Add Object (G-2 / T-1). Add material pass... adds Deferred geometry with its five G-buffer targets and depth filled as it opens (G-1 / T-1). Add fullscreen pass... after the geometry, New... > Deferred lighting (G-3), which fills the five inputs from the G-buffer names and turns on Uses scene lights and Camera position (T-1); its colour output is made from the output list's New target: deferred_lighting_color... (T-1). present reads it through a Tone map shader New... writes (G-3): the Blank pipeline's present draws with engine://passthrough (VI-2), so the proposal is the pass's own name, and the fragment list offers the new shader (T-1). The light paints the two faces in different colours; turning the light in the Inspector changes them.
